observedFailures: Both excessive-header tests expected application HTTP 431 but observed actual HTTP 400. The run retained 80 passes, two subtest assertion failures, and their failed parent: 83 tests, 3 failures.
diagnostic: An exact owned listener returned HTTP 400, Connection: close, an empty body, and audit.requestsUsed=0. Node refused the excessive-header request before the profile handler. Its actual listener was then closed.
refinement: Accept defensive parser HTTP 400 only with empty body and unchanged application request count, or application HTTP 431 with HEADER_LIMIT. HTTP success is never accepted. Both raw-count guard and native header/byte limits remain in place.
